question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Confiscate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"confiscate"** means to take or seize someone's property with authority. (जब्त करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The police **confiscated** the illegal drugs found in the suspect's house.
 
 
 
• **"Seize" **refers to taking hold of something suddenly and forcibly. (कब्जा करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The customs officers **seized** the contraband at the airport.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'confiscate' **is **'seize'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Seize**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Restock **(फिर से भरना): To refill or replenish supplies.

 
 
• **Example:** We need to restock the pantry with groceries.
 
 
 
• **Destroy **(नष्ट करना): To cause something to end or no longer exist.
 
 
• **Example: **The hurricane destroyed many homes along the coast.
 
 
 
• **Titivate** (सजाना): To make small enhancing adjustments to something.
 
 
• **Example:** She decided to titivate her appearance before the big event.
